newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian share volume slumps, Unibanka unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Latvian share volume slumps, Unibanka unchanged.

text.p: Volume on the Latvian stock exchange slumped to 45,714 lats on Wednesday after yesterday's more than 120,000 lat turnover.
Shares in market leader Unibanka were unchanged at 2.11 lats on a turnover of 21,146 lats.
Riga Transport Fleet, with Unibanka on the official list, traded 4,800 and rose slightly to 96 santimes from 95 santimes.
On the secondary list, Kaija was the most active on a healthy volume of 12,694 lats and gained further to 1.27 lats from 1.11 lats.
The Riga Yeast factory turned over 3,175 lats and gained to 1.27 lats from 1.11 lats.
